# PolyBench/GPU (sgrauerg/polybenchGpu 5584aaa), MINI_DATASET, built for sm_86 with CUDA 13.0.
# Each compares its GPU result with its own CPU reference and prints how many outputs
# differ beyond its threshold. Columns: benchmark | source directory | the RTX 3060's counts.
# Left out: MVT (a race in the benchmark: 8 threads update each x1[i]), GEMVER (prints no
# count), DOITGEN (does not compile), and 2MM, FDTD-2D and GRAMSCHM, which match but take
# 3 to 11 minutes each even at MINI_DATASET (2048^2 here), more than the nightly's
# 10-minute limit on the runner's 4 CPUs.
# GESUMMV is in the list but reads two host arrays it never initialises (`tmp` and `y` are copied to the device as they are, and the kernel
# does `+=` on them): its count is 0 only while the process heap is clean. An A10G card gives 0 with a clean heap and 512 of 512 under
# MALLOC_PERTURB_=170; the simulator gives 342 (a10g), 39 (h100) or 0 depending on what the heap held (2026-11-23, issue #757).
2DCONV|2DCONV|0
3DCONV|3DCONV|0
3MM|3MM|0
ADI|ADI|1
ATAX|ATAX|0
BICG|BICG|0
CORR|CORR|0
COVAR|COVAR|0
GEMM|GEMM|0
GESUMMV|GESUMMV|0
JACOBI1D|JACOBI1D|0
JACOBI2D|JACOBI2D|0
LU|LU|0
SYR2K|SYR2K|0
SYRK|SYRK|0
